1. (Currently amended) A cell comprising: a non-native compartment comprising a proteinaceous shell comprising at least one bacterial microcompartment (BMC) polypeptide, __wherein the non-native compartment is in a eukaryotic cell__.

2. (Currently amended) The cell of claim [[1]] __1__ wherein the non-native compartment is self-assembled in vivo.

3. (Currently amended) The cell of claim [[1]] __1__ wherein the non-native compartment further comprises at least one targeted enzyme.

4. (Previously presented) The cell of claim3wherein the non-native compartment comprises a plurality of different targeted enzymes.

5. (Currently amended) The cell of [[eihe* claim3er-ctaim-4]] __either claim 3 or claim 4__ wherein the at least one targeted enzyme comprises a compartment-specific targeting signal sequence.

6. (Currently amended) The cell of [[claim1any-preceding-claim]] __any preceding claim__ wherein the BMC polypeptide comprises a Eut polypeptide.

7. (Currently amended) The cell of claim [[6]] __6__ wherein the Eut polypeptide comprises a EutS polypeptide.

8. (Currently amended) The cell of [[claim1any pr-eceding-claim]] __any preceding claim__ wherein the proteinaceous shell comprises a plurality of different BMC polypeptides.

9. (Previously presented) The cell of claim8wherein the plurality of different BMC polypeptides comprises BMC polypeptides from different bacterial species.

10. (Previously presented) The cell of claim8wherein the plurality of different BMC polypeptides comprises BMC polypeptides from different BMC operons.

11. (Currently amended) The cell of [[claim1any-preeeding-claim]] __any preceding claim__ wherein at least one BMC polypeptide comprises an affinity tag.

12. (Currently amended) A method __for producing a non-native compartment in a eukaryotic host cell__ comprising: introducing into a host cell a polynucleotide that encodes at least one BMC polypeptide, thereby producing a transformed cell; and growing the transformed cell under conditions effective for the transformed cell to express the polynucleotide that encodes at least one BMC polypeptide and produce a non-native compartment comprising a proteinaceous shell comprising the at least one BMC polypeptide.

13. (Previously presented) The method of claim12wherein the host cell comprises a bacterium.

14. (Previously presented) The method of claim13wherein the bacterium comprises a member of the family Enterobacteriaceae.

15. (Previously presented) The method of claim14wherein the member of the family Enterobacteriaceae comprises E. coli.

16. (Previously presented) The method of claim13wherein the bacterium comprises a member of the family Shewanellaceae.

17. (Previously presented) The method of claim12wherein the host cell comprises a yeast.

18. (Previously presented) The method of claim17wherein the yeast comprises a member of the family Saccharomycetaceae.

19. (Previously presented) The method of claim18wherein the member of the family Saccharomycetaceae comprises Saccharomyces cerevisiae.

20. (Previously presented) The method of claim12wherein the host cell comprises an alga.

21. (Currently amended) A method __for producing a product in a eukaryotic cell__ comprising: providing a cell comprising a non-native compartment comprising: a proteinaceous shell comprising at least one bacterial microcompartment (BMC) polypeptide, and at least one enzyme that catalyzes conversion of a substrate to a product; and growing the cell under conditions effective for the at least one enzyme to catalyze conversion of the substrate to a product.

22. (Previously presented) The method of claim21wherein the product comprises a bioactive product.

23. (Previously presented) The method of claim21wherein the product comprises a drug or a drug precursor.

24. (Previously presented) The method of claim21wherein the product comprises a biofuel or a precursor of biofuel production.

25. (Previously presented) The method of claim21wherein the at least one enzyme catalyzes a step in degrading or detoxifying a toxic substrate.

26. (Previously presented) The method of claim21further comprising isolating at least a portion of the non-native compartments.

27. (Previously presented) The method of claim26wherein at least a portion of the non-native compartment comprise an affinity tag and isolating at least a portion of the non-native compartments comprises contacting a sample comprising the non-native compartments with an affinity substrate having selective affinity for the affinity tag.

28. (Currently amended) The cell of [[claim1anye nee f-elaims-1-11]] __any one of claims 1-11__ comprising a plurality of compartments.
